[DAY2 22:56:30 - DAY2 22:57:00]
I look around at everyone, glance toward Choiszt, and hold my leg. Lucia: "It's really practical." Shure: "Yes, it's very practical." I nod and smile in agreement. Shure: "If any student wants to come and stay, that's definitely not a problem." Shure: "They are absolutely welcome." I'm sitting and quietly listening as Shure explains his room layout. Shure: "1, 2, 3, 4, 5, up to five people can join in." Lucia: "And there are so many pillows." Lucia: "So if anyone wants a pillow fight, that's possible too." I keep listening.

[DAY2 17:15:30 - DAY2 17:15:59]
I look around and walk forward, glance in the mirror, then enter Shure's room and start chatting. "Hey, your shoes are the same model!" I say. "How did you manage that?" I ask. Shure: "Uh, not really. I just bought some with rainbow elements, but I'm not actually into that." I step back and say, "Oh." I turn on my phone. Shure: "I need to tie my hair up, it's too long." I open WeChat and use my phone.

[DAY2 22:55:01 - DAY2 22:55:30]
I walk with Shure. "Come on, just us," I say. I head downstairs with Shure. "Okay, okay, okay," I say. I walk down the stairs step by step, steadying myself briefly against the wall, and continue down with Shure. I arrive on the first floor and enter the living room with Shure. I glance at the dining table and look toward Shure's room. "Hmm, pretty clean," I say. I walk into Shure's room. "When I was sweeping earlier," I say.
